objects.name: Detection technique coverage: powershell-loading-dotnet-into-memory-via-reflection
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of PowerShell scripts to load .NET assemblies into memory via reflection, a technique often used in malicious activities such as those by Empire and Cobalt Strike. It leverages PowerShell Script Block Logging (EventCode=4104) to capture and analyze the full command executed.
